purpose: Technical smoke of the QLoRA adaptation pipeline mechanics (frozen base, trainable adapter, separate save/reload, resume, evidence finalisation) on a tiny deterministic source_train subset. Never a training-quality or official-result claim.

base_model_policy.note: The base checkpoint referenced by selected_base_model is loaded read-only and is never fine-tuned, merged with the adapter, or rewritten on disk.

training.note: max_steps is deliberately far below anything used for a real run; this config exists to prove mechanics, not to produce a usable adapter.

output.note: Adapter weights are always written under outputs/, never into the pinned base snapshot or the pinned vLLM inference SIF cache.

evaluation.note: This smoke performs no held-out or manual/protected evaluation; dev/holdout/manual gates remain reserved for later tickets (T28+).

notes: Designed to run before Phase D sets selected_base_model; require_selected_base_model() in src/ambiguity_manager/model/qlora_smoke.py raises until then.

Local development runs use the deterministic mock training harness (no torch/transformers/peft/bitsandbytes required); the real 4-bit path only runs inside the pinned training container on the cluster.
technical_smoke_only=true, selected_adapter=false, and valid_for_official_use=false are enforced on every run result; the smoke adapter can never become the official selected_adapter.
